# LEI.info

> > LEI.info is a comprehensive SaaS platform for searching, registering, and managing Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI) with global coverage and KYC compliance solutions.

LEI.info provides an integrated solution for entity identification and financial transparency through LEI registration, data management, and KYC services. The platform leverages the ISO 17442 standard and maintains partnerships with GLEIF to support the global LEI ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)
- LEI registration
- ISO 17442 standard
- KYC compliance
- GLEIF
- SaaS platform
- Entity identification
- LEI Code
- Common Data Format (CDF)
- Business identifier
- Global coverage
- Data integration
- Semantic Web
- Financial transparency
- Linked Data

## Core Services

- [Legal Entity Identifier | Search LEI code](https://lei.info): LEI.INFO homepage: search LEI numbers and legal entity information globally
- [LEI number registration - LEI register](https://lei.info/portal/lei-code-registration): LEI number registration portal for companies to register LEI codes
- [LEI number registration - LEI register](https://lei.info/portal/get-your-lei): LEI registration guide for companies seeking LEI code identification
- [Our services related to the Legal Entity Identifier](https://lei.info/portal/services): LEI.INFO services: search engine, registration, data exploration, integrations
- [Browse the LEI catalog of All countries](https://lei.info/catalog): Browsable catalog of LEI codes by country with global entity lookup
